questions.q: Where does the rule for choosing an aircraft for an applied job start?
options: With a description of the job in one sentence with numbers: what, where, how much, how accurately, over whom
With choosing firmware that supports the required payload and release mechanism
With checking which aircraft are already in the fleet and what they can carry
With calculating the radio link budget for the maximum range
questions.explain: The order is the reverse of “from the aircraft”: job → six requirements → class by the tree → positioning → regulatory corridor. The aircraft and firmware follow from the requirements.

questions.q: Swath width 7 m, speed 6 m/s. What is the theoretical productivity of the sprayer?
options: 4.2 ha/h
42 ha/h
questions.explain: P = B·v·3600/10,000 = 7·6·0.36 = 15.12 ha/h. 10.58 ha/h is already with the utilization factor of 0.7 (turns, refilling), not the theoretical value.

questions.q: ArduCopter 4.7.2, `SPRAY_PUMP_RATE = 10`, `SPRAY_PUMP_MIN = 0`. What happens to the application rate at a pass speed of 12 m/s?
options: The rate stays constant: the pump duty grows in proportion to speed without limits
Spraying turns off because the speed is above `SPRAY_SPEED_MIN`
The pump hits 100 % already at 10 m/s, and at 12 m/s the rate per hectare drops
The pump switches to `SPRAY_PUMP_MIN`, and the rate drops to zero
questions.explain: In `AC_Sprayer.cpp` the pump duty = speed·SPRAY_PUMP_RATE, limited to 100 %. At 10 %/(m/s) saturation occurs at 10 m/s; above that the flow does not grow while the area per minute does — the rate per hectare drops. `SPRAY_SPEED_MIN` is the lower turn-on threshold, not an upper one.

questions.q: Why does a sprayer under Part 107 need an exemption from § 107.36?
options: § 107.36 limits flight altitude to 400 feet above the ground
§ 107.36 prohibits flying at night without anti-collision lights
§ 107.36 prohibits one pilot from operating several aircraft
§ 107.36 prohibits a small UAV from carrying hazardous materials (hazmat)
questions.explain: § 107.36: “A small unmanned aircraft may not carry hazardous material”. So for aircraft lighter than 55 pounds the FAA grants an exemption from § 107.36 and a number of Part 137 rules; heavier ones go through Parts 91 and 137.

questions.q: You need to record the temperature of contacts at a substation in a report. Which thermal camera, and why?
questions.fragment:
Target: a 10 cm contact
Camera A: radiometric, 640x512, 12 µm pixel, f = 13 mm
Camera B: non-radiometric, 640x512, 12 µm pixel, f = 13 mm
Planned distance: 30 m
options: B: with the same sensor and lens the only difference is the price
A: only a radiometric one records the pixel temperature, and 30 m is less than D_max = 36.1 m
A, but from 30 m the target is smaller than 3×3 pixels, you have to fly in to 10 m
B: at 30 m the target covers more than 3×3 pixels, which is enough for a measurement
questions.explain: Degrees in a report mean quantitative thermography, which needs a radiometric camera. D_max = L·f/(3p) = 0.10·0.013/(3·12e-6) = 36.1 m, so 30 m fits within FLIR's 3×3 rule.

questions.q: A show: a 60 × 30 m picture with a 3 m spacing, ordinary GNSS with an error of 2.5 m. What conclusion follows from the module's rule?
options: 231 aircraft; the spacing-to-error ratio of 1.2 is less than three, RTK is needed
200 aircraft; GNSS is enough if the show is raised above 120 m
231 aircraft; GNSS is enough because the spacing is larger than the position error
200 aircraft; RTK is needed because the error is larger than the spacing
questions.explain: N = (⌊60/3⌋ + 1)·(⌊30/3⌋ + 1) = 21·11 = 231. The ratio 3/2.5 = 1.2 < 3, so without RTK (1–10 cm per Skybrush) the picture does not hold. You get 200 if you forget the +1 — the edge rows.

questions.q: What is the Skybrush onboard firmware for outdoor show drones built on?
options: On PX4 with a swarm module that has been part of the PX4 main branch since 1.15
On Betaflight with GPS Rescue and an external trajectory controller
On a modified ArduCopter, which you build and flash yourself
On closed firmware; only the server and the ground control station are open
questions.explain: The Skybrush documentation calls the firmware “the Skybrush fork of the ArduPilot firmware”; the FAQ requires building and installing a modified version of ArduCopter, a flight controller with ArduPilot support and a microSD, with 2 MB of flash recommended.

questions.q: What is needed in the USA for commercial delivery of other people's packages by drone beyond visual line of sight (November 2026)?
options: Only a § 107.31 waiver for BVLOS: Part 107 covers any work for compensation
A Part 108 certificate, which took effect in the summer of 2026
A Part 107 certificate and aircraft registration with Remote ID
A Part 135 certificate, an airspace authorization and a BVLOS exemption or waiver
questions.explain: FAA: Part 135 is the only path for small UAVs to carry another person's property BVLOS; § 107.205 expressly prohibits a waiver of § 107.25 and § 107.31 from allowing the carriage of another person's property for compensation. As of 2026-11-22 Part 108 is under OIRA review and not published.

questions.q: Delivery: 8 km one way, 15 m/s, a 30 m line at 1 m/s down and up, a 60 s hover, a 30 % reserve. How much flight time is needed?
options: 19.8 min
25.7 min
28.3 min
17.8 min
questions.explain: t = 2·8000/15 + 2·30/1 + 60 = 1067 + 60 + 60 = 1187 s = 19.8 min; with the reserve t/(1 − 0.3) = 28.3 min. 19.8 is without the reserve, 17.8 is the cruise only.

questions.q: Which of these is true for the EU regarding spraying from drones as of November 2026?
options: Spraying is allowed in subcategory A3 of Open if the aircraft is lighter than 25 kg
Art. 9 of Directive 2009/128/EC prohibits aerial spraying with exceptions; the amendment for UAS is still a draft
EASA has issued a standard scenario STS-03 for agricultural works, by declaration
The ban was lifted by Regulation 2019/947: for agricultural works an operational authorization from the national aviation authority is enough
questions.explain: Art. 9(1): member states prohibit aerial spraying; 9(2) — exceptions under strict conditions. On 16.12.2025 the Commission proposed allowing member states to take certain types of UAS out of the ban (2025/0409(COD)) — that is a proposal. On the aviation side it is the Specific category.
